author: pre-PR green-gate fix (studio-2.0 merge, synced_reader branch)
summary: Fixed a pre-existing `npm run build` break on studio-2.0's tip (confirmed on a clean checkout, unrelated to the synced-reader feature): PR #146's ArchetypeQuickPick.tsx imported `type MouseEvent` from 'react' for a JSX onClick handler, which shadowed the global DOM `MouseEvent` type for the whole file. A second handler in the same file, passed to `document.addEventListener('mousedown', ...)`, was annotated with that same shadowed (React) `MouseEvent` type instead of the DOM one `addEventListener` expects, so `tsc -b` failed with TS2769 (no overload matches).

changes.change: Line ~260: annotated the document.addEventListener('mousedown', ...) handler's parameter as `globalThis.MouseEvent` instead of the file-shadowed React `MouseEvent` import. Pure type-annotation fix, zero runtime behavior change; the JSX onClick handler elsewhere in the file (line ~151) correctly keeps the React MouseEvent type.

invariants: No new invariant; this restores the pre-existing (intended) behavior of the click-outside-to-close handler, which was type-correct in intent but mistyped due to an unrelated import shadowing the same identifier.
note: Found while pre-verifying a green build/test gate before opening a PR for an unrelated feature (synced player-piano reader). Confirmed via a clean `origin/studio-2.0` checkout that this break pre-dates and is unrelated to that feature branch.
